gen-press-start-2p-gf-mitr: Press Start 2P spaces its cut-out style letters far apart, retro and playful. It does the fun, while Mitr, a plain sans, does the approachable talking, with barely any gap between its lowercase and capitals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-momo-trust-display: Letters pinned far apart like cut-outs give Press Start 2P its retro, playful look. Momo Trust Display drifts wide and tall in the middle, handling the clean reading while the heading handles the fun.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mukta: Press Start 2P brings a retro, playful look, its cut-out style letters pinned far apart and gently tapered at the joints. Its strength: Mukta, a plain sans, stays out of the way.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mukta-mahee: Chunky, tall-bodied lowercase makes this body text feel approachable and clear. Mukta Mahee, a plain sans, would keep going comfortably paragraph after paragraph beneath Press Start 2P's playful curves.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mukta-malar: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P lets its stroke weight shift noticeably without ever turning dramatic. But Mukta Malar, a sans with short, compressed ascenders, stays neutral and approachable underneath.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-mukta-vaani: Press Start 2P is retro fun, pinned apart like cut-out letters. It brings medium-contrast strokes and fun, while Mukta Vaani, a sans-serif with a high-waisted lowercase, brings the contemporary, quiet reading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-narnoor: Cut-out letters pinned far apart, with a modest pencil-line taper, give Press Start 2P its retro, playful face. Narnoor, a plain sans with short ascenders over big bowls, keeps things tidy.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-display: Spaced out like cut-outs, retro and playful: that's Press Start 2P. Noto Sans Display, a sans with a big, tall middle zone in every word, keeps paragraphs approachable and unfussy, far from the heading's shimmer.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-play: Play, a sans, reads clean and professional, with little height difference between cases and faint weight differences between upstrokes and downstrokes. Press Start 2P adds the retro fun while Play keeps it tidy.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-port-lligat-sans: Retro fun comes first, thanks to Press Start 2P's slightly shadowed strokes. Port Lligat Sans, a sans with tightly packed characters and bowls left unfinished on one side, feels modern and plain beneath it.
